title: kraftwerk project config
description: kraftwerk.yml at the project root: config file and root marker for the kraftwerk CLI. All fields are optional — an empty file is valid.

name.description: Display name of the project ("environment"), shown in the inspector header and browser tab

icon.description: Emoji used as the inspector favicon (browser-tab icon), e.g. "⚡"

port.description: Port `kraftwerk ui` listens on. Default: 1981 (the --port flag wins over this)

workflows.description: Workflows root relative to this file. Default: src/workflows or workflows

output.description: Run-artifact directory relative to this file. Default: output

knowledge.description: OKF knowledge-bundle root relative to this file. Default: knowledge

agents.description: Team agent-definition root relative to this file. Default: agents

skills.description: Workspace skill root (one folder per skill with a SKILL.md) relative to this file. Default: skills

switcher.description: Other kraftwerk workspaces, shown as a switcher dropdown on the workspace name in the inspector header

name.description: Display name of the other workspace

url.description: URL the other workspace's inspector runs on, e.g. "https://localhost:1985"

icon.description: Optional emoji shown next to the entry, e.g. "🛰"
